model: Test model with several levels, at least one level with two floor plans, one level with no ceiling plan and one level with no floor plan. The saved model has no sheet numbered A-101. Replace every angle-bracket placeholder with a real name from this model before running.
note: Fourteen prompts, each run twice on the backend branch feat/copilot-runnable-playbooks. Each step is one drafter message. Reopen the model without saving and start a new Copilot chat before every step. FP1 = number of levels with exactly one floor plan, written down once by the tester. The Copilot must not choose between two plans for the drafter, must ask before it creates something that was not asked for, and must not ask about sheet numbers (the prefix A- and the first number 101 are defaults). When a question comes back, answer from the table in sheets-method-test.md, by the topic of the question. 'expect' is what to check in Revit afterwards. Default plan type is floor plan. Numbers must be unique, start at the first number and skip no free number.

steps.text: Create a sheet for every level using the <Title Block> title block.
steps.expect: One question back before any sheet exists, after the script ran: which floor plan to use for <Level With Two Plans>, naming both of its plans, and, for each level with no floor plan, create one or skip it. Not two questions, and no question about those levels before the script ran. No question about sheet numbers. After you answer <Plan Name> and skip for each level with no floor plan: FP1 + 1 new sheets, one for each level that has a floor plan, and the sheet for <Level With Two Plans> holds <Plan Name> only. No floor plan is created. The reply says which levels were skipped. Numbers A-101 onwards, all unique, none skipped while free. Each plan placed once, near the centre. Nothing else in the model changed.

steps.text: Make sheets for <Level A> and <Level B>, floor plans, title block <Title Block>.
steps.expect: No question. Exactly two new sheets, numbered A-101 and A-102. One holds the floor plan of <Level A>, the other of <Level B>, each placed once. No sheet for any other level. Nothing else changed.

steps.text: I need ceiling plan sheets for <Level A> and <Level B> with the <Title Block> title block.
steps.expect: No question. Two new sheets, each holding the ceiling plan (not the floor plan) of its level, placed once. No floor plan is placed on a new sheet. Nothing else changed.

steps.text: Create floor plan sheets for all levels with title block <Title Block>. Number them S-201, S-202 and so on.
steps.expect: One question back before any sheet exists, after the script ran: which floor plan to use for <Level With Two Plans>, naming both of its plans, and, for each level with no floor plan, create one or skip it. Not two questions, and no question about those levels before the script ran. No question about sheet numbers. After you answer <Plan Name> and skip for each level with no floor plan: FP1 + 1 new sheets numbered S-201 upwards, all unique, none skipped while free. No new sheet starts with A-. No floor plan is created. The reply says which levels were skipped. Each floor plan placed once. Nothing else changed.

steps.area: Sheets: levels named loosely by number (Malay)
steps.text: Buat sheet untuk level <N1> dan level <N2>, floor plan, title block <Title Block>.
steps.expect: Replace <N1> and <N2> with level numbers as a drafter says them (for example 1 and 3), where the model's levels have names such as Level 1 and Level 3. Pick two levels that each have exactly one floor plan. No question, unless a number matches more than one level. Two new sheets, A-101 and A-102, one for each of those two levels, each floor plan placed once. No wrong level is used. Nothing else changed.

steps.text: Buat sheet untuk <Level A> dengan <Level B> ye.
steps.expect: Floor plans are the default plan type. One question back about which title block to use, with no field for sheet numbers, and no sheet exists yet. After you answer with <Title Block>, two sheets are made, each with that title block and its level's floor plan placed once. It must not pick a title block by itself. Nothing else changed.

steps.area: Sheets: level with two plans of the type (Malay)
steps.text: Buat sheet untuk <Level With Two Plans>, floor plan, title block <Title Block>. Guna plan <Plan Name> ye.
steps.expect: No question. One new sheet for <Level With Two Plans> holding only the plan <Plan Name>, placed once. The other plan of that level is not placed. Nothing else changed.

steps.text: Buat sheet floor plan untuk <Level A> dan <Level B>, title block <Title Block>, nombor mula A-101.
steps.expect: Setup for this step only: right after reopening the model, create a sheet numbered A-101 by hand. Then run the prompt. No question. Two new sheets with the next free numbers (A-102 and A-103), none duplicating an existing number. The reply says A-101 was already in use. The hand-made A-101 sheet is unchanged. Each plan placed once. Nothing else changed.

steps.area: Sheets: no levels said, many levels in model (Malay)
steps.text: Boleh buat sheet untuk floor plan? Title block <Title Block>.
steps.expect: Floor plans are the default plan type. Before any sheet exists the Copilot asks which levels. After you answer 'semua level' it runs the script, then asks one question: which floor plan to use for <Level With Two Plans>, naming both of its plans, and, for each level with no floor plan, create one or skip it. Two questions in all; a third (the plan-less levels asked on their own) is not needed (write it in the notes column). No field for sheet numbers. After you answer <Plan Name> and skip for each level with no floor plan: FP1 + 1 new sheets, one for each level that has a floor plan, and the sheet for <Level With Two Plans> holds <Plan Name> only. No floor plan is created. The reply says which levels were skipped. Nothing else changed.

steps.area: Sheets: a level with no plan of the asked type (Malay)
steps.text: Buat sheet ceiling plan untuk <Level Without Ceiling Plan>, title block <Title Block>.
steps.expect: One question back before anything is made: it says <Level Without Ceiling Plan> has no ceiling plan and offers to create one. No sheet and no view exists until you answer. First repeat, answer 'tak payah': no sheet, no new view, and the reply says the level has no ceiling plan. Second repeat, answer 'ya, buat': one new ceiling plan for that level and one sheet that holds it, with the title block. Nothing else changed in either repeat.

steps.area: Sheets: a level with no floor plan (English)
steps.text: Make a floor plan sheet for <Level Without Floor Plan> with the <Title Block> title block.
steps.expect: One question back before anything is made: it says <Level Without Floor Plan> has no floor plan and offers to create one. Answer 'no'. No sheet, no new view. Nothing in the model changed.

steps.area: Tags: the plan to tag does not exist (Malay)
steps.text: tag semua pintu dalam pelan <Level Without Floor Plan>
steps.expect: One question back that says there is no plan for <Level Without Floor Plan>. No view and no tag is created before the answer. Answer 'tak payah'. Nothing in the model changed.

steps.area: Parameters: the type named does not exist (English)
steps.text: Set Comments of door type ZZ9-TIADA to LIVETEST
steps.expect: The model has no door type named ZZ9-TIADA. The Copilot says so and names real door types, as a question or as a plain reply (write which in the notes column). No type is created or duplicated and no parameter is written. If it asked, answer 'tak payah'. Nothing in the model changed.

steps.area: Parameters: a plain write still works (English)
steps.text: Set Comments to LIVETEST on the doors of type <Door Type> on <Level A>.
steps.expect: No question. Only the doors of type <Door Type> on <Level A> have Comments set to LIVETEST. Doors of the same type on other levels are unchanged. The result card reports the count applied and 0 failed. Then click Undo on the result card and check that the Comments are back.
